params.name: datetime_start
params.description: ISO8601 datetime for the start of the range (format: 2022-12-01T00:00:00Z).

params.name: datetime_end
params.description: ISO8601 datetime for the end of the range (format: 2022-12-31T23:59:59Z).

params.name: accuracy
params.description: Accuracy of the time-series data points.

params.name: base_currency
params.description: The base currency to which all results are behaving relative to. Defaults to USD.

params.name: currencies
params.description: A list of comma-separated currency codes you want to receive (e.g. EUR,USD,CAD). Defaults to all available currencies.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of currency you want to get. Defaults to all types.

items.docs: Returns exchange rate data for a datetime range in a single call. Accuracy constraints - day covers up to 366 days of history; hour allows a maximum 7-day range up to 3 months back; quarter_hour allows a maximum 24-hour range up to 7 days back; minute allows a maximum 6-hour range up to 7 days back.
